exposure: insufficient self-rated pre-pregnancy level of physical activity
outcome: low to moderate overall physical activity
cohort: The study included 386 pregnant females during their last trimester, attending Mansoura University Hospital in Egypt in 2022.
finding: An extremely high prevalence of insufficient physical activity was found among pregnant women (87-95.6%), with caesarean delivery, insufficient self-rated pre-pregnancy physical activity, absence of hypertension during pregnancy, and increased BMI being significant predictors of low to moderate overall physical activity.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was identified as a significant predictor of low to moderate overall physical activity.
cross-section timing: During the last trimester of pregnancy in 2022.
gest_age: Mothers in their last trimester of pregnancy
